items.title: Targeting the DFG-out conformation of TTBK1 enables the discovery of selective type II neuroprotective inhibitors.
items.summary: Tau Tubulin Kinase 1 (TTBK1) is an emerging therapeutic target for neurodegenerative diseases because it promotes the pathological phosphorylation of tau and TDP-43, key drivers of Alzheimer's disease (AD) and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, the development of selective TTBK1 inhibitors is hindered by the high structural similarity between TTBK1 and the essential paralog TTBK2, making ATP-competitive strategies challenging. Here, we report the discovery of computationally supported type II TTBK1 inhibitors by targeting the inactive DFG-out kinase conformation. A druggable DFG-out model was generated using metadynamics and molecular dynamic simulations and employed for virtual screening of the MBC chemical library. This approach identified novel chemotypes that were validated as selective TTBK1 inhibitors with improved discrimination over TTBK2. The most promising compounds also displayed neuroprotective activity in SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells. These findings demonstrate that targeting the inactive TTBK1 conformation is a viable strategy to achieve isoform selectivity and establish a new framework for developing disease-modifying therapies for ALS, AD, and other TTBK1-driven neurodegenerative disorders.

items.titleZh: 靶向TTBK1的DFG-out构象可实现选择性II型神经保护抑制剂的发现
items.summaryZh: 研究团队通过计算机模拟构建TTBK1失活态（DFG-out）结构模型，并据此虚拟筛选化合物库，发现了一类对TTBK1选择性优于TTBK2的II型抑制剂；其中部分候选化合物在SH-SY5Y细胞中显示出神经保护作用。该工作为绕过TTBK1/TTBK2高度相似难题提供了新思路。
items.insight: TTBK1是tau和TDP-43磷酸化的上游激酶，与ALS病理直接相关，但因其与TTBK2高度同源，选择性抑制剂长期难以获得。该研究提出靶向失活构象而非ATP口袋的II型策略，并给出可成药的DFG-out模型与初步细胞活性数据，为ALS领域提供了一个可跟进的新化学骨架和结构设计框架，后续需关注其选择性谱、脑渗透性及体内验证。

aiRead.keyFinding: 靶向TTBK1 DFG-out构象可获对TTBK2选择性更优的II型抑制剂，部分化合物在SH-SY5Y细胞中具神经保护活性。
aiRead.limitation: 仅为细胞与计算层面证据，缺乏动物体内药效、药代动力学及脑渗透性数据，选择性谱和脱靶效应尚未全面评估。

items.abstractZh: Tau微管蛋白激酶1（TTBK1）是神经退行性疾病的新兴治疗靶点，因其促进tau和TDP-43的病理性磷酸化，而这两者是阿尔茨海默病（AD）和肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的关键驱动因素。然而，TTBK1与必需旁系同源物TTBK2之间高度结构相似，阻碍了选择性TTBK1抑制剂的开发，使ATP竞争性策略面临挑战。在此，我们报告通过靶向失活DFG-out激酶构象，发现经计算支持的II型TTBK1抑制剂。利用元动力学和分子动力学模拟生成可成药的DFG-out模型，并将其用于MBC化合物库的虚拟筛选。该方法鉴定出新型化学型，经证实为选择性TTBK1抑制剂，对TTBK2的区分度提高。最有前景的化合物还在SH-SY5Y神经母细胞瘤细胞中表现出神经保护活性。这些发现表明，靶向TTBK1失活构象是实现亚型选择性的可行策略，并为开发针对ALS、AD及其他TTBK1驱动的神经退行性疾病的疾病修饰疗法建立了新框架。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年提出靶向TTBK1失活DFG-out构象的II型抑制剂新策略，直接针对ALS相关的tau/TDP-43病理，具有转化潜力。

items.title: Immunometabolic dysregulation of reactive microglia and astrocytes in neurodegenerative diseases: Mechanistic insights and therapeutic implications.
items.summary: Neurodegenerative diseases (NDDs) are increasingly understood as multifactorial disorders characterized by intertwined pathological processes, in which metabolic dysfunction may act as a critical and potentially disease-amplifying contributor to the proteinopathy-driven pathological cascade. Despite growing recognition that microglial and astrocytic metabolism governs central nervous system tissue damage-repair homeostasis, intercellular metabolic crosstalk between glia and neurons remains insufficiently synthesized across major NDDs. This review delineates how core metabolic pathways, including glycolysis, mitochondrial respiration, lipid processing, and amino acid transport, shape glial reactivity in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. We highlight glial metabolic reprogramming, a proposed theoretical framework arising from severe glial metabolic dysregulation. Within this framework, persistent pathological stress may drive reactive glia to sequester local energy substrates in excess, which is hypothesized to trigger bioenergetic failure in neighboring neurons. Broad-spectrum anti-inflammatory agents show poor clinical performance because they only block cytokine outputs rather than reverse glial metabolic exhaustion. Therapeutic efforts should therefore shift toward restoring glial metabolic flexibility. Cell-type-specific metabolic reprogramming, instead of pan-metabolic suppression, may circumvent systemic adverse effects. Precision strategies targeting such intercellular metabolic imbalance could provide promising cell-resolved metabolic avenues to retard NDD progression.
items.titleZh: 神经退行性疾病中反应性小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的免疫代谢失调：机制见解与治疗意义
items.summaryZh: 这篇综述提出，在阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化等神经退行性疾病中，反应性小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞存在代谢失调，表现为糖酵解、线粒体呼吸、脂质加工和氨基酸转运等核心代谢途径的改变。作者提出“胶质细胞代谢重编程”理论框架，认为持续病理应激可导致反应性胶质细胞过度摄取局部能量底物，进而引发邻近神经元能量衰竭。广谱抗炎药仅阻断细胞因子输出，无法逆转胶质细胞代谢耗竭，因此临床效果不佳。治疗策略应转向恢复胶质细胞代谢灵活性，采用细胞类型特异性代谢重编程而非泛代谢抑制，以精准靶向细胞间代谢失衡，延缓疾病进展。
items.insight: 该综述为ALS研究提供了超越传统神经炎症视角的代谢维度：将小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的代谢重编程置于疾病进展的核心，解释了广谱抗炎策略在ALS临床试验中屡屡失败的可能原因，并指出细胞类型特异性代谢干预（而非泛抑制）是更具转化潜力的方向。对于关注神经炎症、线粒体功能障碍和生物标志物（如NfL）的ALS研究者，该框架有助于设计联合代谢调节与抗炎策略的临床前和临床研究。

aiRead.keyFinding: 反应性胶质细胞的代谢重编程（而非单纯炎症因子释放）可能是神经退行性疾病中神经元能量衰竭的关键驱动因素，广谱抗炎药因未靶向代谢耗竭而疗效有限。
aiRead.limitation: 本文为综述，提出的“胶质细胞代谢重编程”框架主要基于现有文献的整合与假设，缺乏原始实验数据验证，且未针对ALS提供具体的代谢靶点或临床转化路径。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续需关注针对小胶质细胞或星形胶质细胞特定代谢通路（如糖酵解、线粒体呼吸、脂质代谢）的细胞类型特异性干预在ALS模型中的临床前验证，以及相关代谢生物标志物在ALS患者中的纵向研究。

items.abstractZh: 神经退行性疾病（NDDs）日益被视为多因素疾病，其特征是相互交织的病理过程，其中代谢功能障碍可能是蛋白质病变驱动的病理级联反应中的关键且潜在放大疾病的因素。尽管越来越多的人认识到小胶质细胞和星形胶质细胞的代谢调控着中枢神经系统组织损伤-修复稳态，但胶质细胞与神经元之间的细胞间代谢串扰在主要NDDs中仍未得到充分综合。本综述阐述了核心代谢途径（包括糖酵解、线粒体呼吸、脂质加工和氨基酸转运）如何塑造阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化中的胶质细胞反应性。我们强调胶质细胞代谢重编程，这是一个由严重胶质细胞代谢失调提出的理论框架。在此框架内，持续的病理应激可能驱动反应性胶质细胞过度隔离局部能量底物，据推测这会引发邻近神经元的生物能量衰竭。广谱抗炎药物临床效果不佳，因为它们仅阻断细胞因子输出，而非逆转胶质细胞代谢耗竭。因此，治疗努力应转向恢复胶质细胞代谢灵活性。细胞类型特异性的代谢重编程，而非泛代谢抑制，可能规避全身性不良反应。针对这种细胞间代谢失衡的精准策略可能提供有前景的细胞分辨率代谢途径，以延缓NDD进展。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述于2026年发表，整合了胶质细胞免疫代谢失调在ALS等神经退行性疾病中的最新机制见解，并提出细胞类型特异性代谢重编程的治疗转化方向，具有新近性和转化价值。

items.title: Expanding Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Genetic Spectrum via Systematic Screening of Adult-Onset Neurologic Disease Genes.
items.summary: Emerging evidence indicates that amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) shares genetic architecture with other neurologic disorders, whose causal variants may be overlooked by targeted sequencing. Here, we evaluated the occurrence of pathogenic variants in genes linked to adult-onset neurologic disorders among individuals with ALS. Short-read WGS was performed in retrospectively collected ALS (Gold Coast criteria) and primary lateral sclerosis (PLS) (consensus diagnostic criteria) patients consecutively recruited at an Italian tertiary referral center (2013-2023), extensively phenotyped to exclude mimics. Pathogenic or likely pathogenic single-nucleotide variants/indels (American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines) and short tandem repeat expansions across 453 genes, including established ALS genes and other neurodegenerative disease genes, were systematically screened and validated. C9orf72 expansions (>30 repeats) were routinely screened by fragment analysis and repeat-primed PCR. A total of 856 patients with ALS and PLS (median age at onset 61.8 years, 38.5% women) were enrolled. Among them, 168 (19.6%) carried pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants or short tandem repeat expansions in genes associated with adult-onset neurologic disorders, mostly autosomal dominant. Of these, 41 (4.8% of the cohort) harbored variants in non-ALS/frontotemporal dementia (FTD) genes (ataxias, neuropathies, myopathies, movement disorders, mitochondrial diseases, and hereditary spastic paraplegia [HSP]). Repeat expansions accounted for 11.9% of cases, while 0.6% carried both sequence variants and repeat expansions. Family history of ALS/FTD ( p = 2.132e-06), other neurodegenerative disorders ( p = 0.0006934), and earlier age at onset ( p = 0.024) were enriched among variant carriers. Variants in genes associated with upper motor neuron (UMN) involvement (ataxias/HSP) did not predict an UMN-predominant phenotype (odds ratio 1.54, 95% CI 0.39-6.07, p = 0.54), while the association between neuropathy/myopathy genes and a lower motor neuron-predominant phenotype was not statistically estimable. Beyond established ALS pathways, enrichment was observed in mitochondrial, metabolic, and proteostasis pathways (false discovery rate ≤0.05). Although the absence of a control cohort limits assessment of variant enrichment, the identification of pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants in genes associated with adult-onset neurologic disorders other than ALS/FTD in patients with ALS supports the inclusion of broader gene panels to advance precision medicine in ALS.
items.titleZh: 通过系统筛查成人起病神经系统疾病基因扩展肌萎缩侧索硬化的遗传谱
items.summaryZh: 这项在856例ALS和PLS患者中开展的全基因组测序研究系统筛查了453个基因，发现19.6%的患者携带与成人起病神经系统疾病相关的致病或可能致病变异，其中4.8%涉及非ALS/FTD基因（如共济失调、神经病、肌病、线粒体病和HSP基因）。重复扩增占11.9%。携带者更常有ALS/FTD或其他神经退行性疾病家族史，且发病年龄更早。研究还发现线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路富集。作者认为，将更广泛的基因组合纳入ALS基因检测有助于精准医学，但缺乏对照队列限制了变异富集程度的判断。
items.insight: 该研究提示，相当一部分ALS患者携带传统ALS/FTD panel之外的神经遗传病基因变异，这对临床基因检测策略、遗传咨询和临床试验入组分层有直接影响。识别这些变异有助于避免误诊、解释非典型表型，并可能揭示新的ALS相关生物学通路（如线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态）。尽管尚无对照队列，这一发现值得ALS研究者关注，尤其是设计更广泛基因panel和精准医学试验时。

aiRead.keyFinding: 19.6%的ALS/PLS患者携带成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病或可能致病变异，其中4.8%涉及非ALS/FTD基因；重复扩增占11.9%；变异携带者家族史更常见且发病更早

items.abstractZh: 新出现的证据表明，肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）与其他神经系统疾病共享遗传架构，其致病性变异可能被靶向测序所遗漏。本研究评估了ALS个体中与成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性变异发生情况。对2013至2023年间在意大利一家三级转诊中心连续招募的、经广泛表型分析排除模拟疾病的ALS（Gold Coast标准）和原发性侧索硬化（PLS）（共识诊断标准）患者，进行回顾性收集的短读长全基因组测序。系统筛查并验证了453个基因中的致病性或可能致病性单核苷酸变异/插入缺失（美国医学遗传学与基因组学学会指南）及短串联重复扩增，包括已知ALS基因和其他神经退行性疾病基因。C9orf72扩增（>30次重复）通过片段分析和重复引物PCR常规筛查。共纳入856例ALS和PLS患者（中位发病年龄61.8岁，女性38.5%）。其中168例（19.6%）携带与成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性或可能致病性变异或短串联重复扩增，多为常染色体显性。其中41例（占队列4.8%）携带非ALS/额颞叶痴呆（FTD）基因（共济失调、神经病、肌病、运动障碍、线粒体疾病和遗传性痉挛性截瘫[HSP]）的变异。重复扩增占病例的11.9%，而0.6%同时携带序列变异和重复扩增。变异携带者中ALS/FTD家族史（p = 2.132e-06）、其他神经退行性疾病家族史（p = 0.0006934）和较早发病年龄（p = 0.024）富集。与上运动神经元（UMN）受累相关的基因（共济失调/HSP）变异不能预测UMN为主表型（比值比1.54，95% CI 0.39-6.07，p = 0.54），而神经病/肌病基因与下运动神经元为主表型之间的关联无法进行统计学估计。除已知ALS通路外，还观察到线粒体、代谢和蛋白稳态通路的富集（错误发现率≤0.05）。尽管缺乏对照队列限制了对变异富集的评估，但在ALS患者中鉴定出与ALS/FTD以外的成人起病神经系统疾病相关基因的致病性或可能致病性变异，支持纳入更广泛的基因组合以推进ALS的精准医学。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大规模全基因组筛查，揭示ALS患者中非ALS/FTD神经遗传病基因致病变异的显著负担，对拓展ALS基因检测和精准医学分层具有直接转化价值。

items.title: Robustness of Plasma P-Tau217 Diagnostic Thresholds for Alzheimer Disease Across Various Clinical Populations and Laboratory Environments.
items.summary: Blood-based biomarkers (BBMs), especially plasma tau phosphorylated at threonine 217 (p-tau217), could scale Alzheimer disease (AD) clinical-biological diagnosis, but clinical use requires thresholds transferable across laboratories and populations. We compared Lumipulse p-tau217 with other BBMs; evaluated amyloid-anchored thresholds across centers, analyzers, reagent lots, and clinical populations; and assessed second-line CSF adjudication of gray zone results. This multicenter, cross-sectional diagnostic-classification study included an exploratory Brussels cohort and 3 external validation cohorts. Brussels participants were cognitively unimpaired or impaired and had Aβ status determined by amyloid-PET or CSF Aβ42 and tau status by tau-PET or CSF p-tau181. Validation cohorts comprised consecutive Paris memory-clinic patients, patients with early-onset neurodegenerative dementia in Bordeaux, and individuals with monogenic frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD). Plasma p-tau217 was measured locally on Lumipulse analyzers. BBMs and ratios were compared using receiver operating characteristic (ROC) analyses. In Brussels, a Youden cutoff and dual 95% or 97.5% sensitivity/specificity cutoffs were derived; intermediate values defined gray zones. Among 411 participants (mean age 70.5 years; 51.6% female), p-tau217 showed the best diagnostic performance; p-tau217/Aβ42 did not improve performance or reduce gray zones. In Brussels, p-tau217 discriminated Aβ+ from Aβ- status (AUC 0.96, 95% CI 0.93-0.98; p < 0.0001). The 0.193 pg/mL Youden cutoff (95% CI 0.178-0.213) yielded 91.5% sensitivity (95% CI 84.7-95.5) and 91.6% specificity (95% CI 84.8-95.5) and detected neocortical tau-PET positivity with 98.5% sensitivity and 81.8% specificity. In Paris, sensitivity/specificity for clinical-biological AD were 93.2% (95% CI 85.1-97.1)/93.0% (95% CI 81.4-97.6); in Bordeaux, sensitivity/specificity for clinical-biological AD were 95.7% (95% CI 79.0-99.2)/92.3% (95% CI 66.7-98.6). Specificity in monogenic FTLD was 88.4% (95% CI 75.5-94.9). False-positive classifications were enriched in FTLD with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Dual thresholds yielded gray zones in 15.4%-24.8% of Paris patients; second-line CSF testing resolved 86.2%-88.9% of gray zone cases. Lumipulse plasma p-tau217 thresholds were transferable across centers, analyzers, reagent lots, and heterogeneous clinical populations, supporting evaluation of plasma-first pathways with confirmatory testing for gray zone values. Values below 0.193 pg/mL made neocortical tauopathy unlikely. Limitations include cross-sectional design, specialized Western European recruitment, unavailable race/ethnicity data, heterogeneous reference standards, incomplete AD copathology adjudication in monogenic FTLD, and no cross-platform comparison.
items.titleZh: 血浆P-Tau217诊断阈值在不同临床人群和实验室环境中的稳健性
items.summaryZh: 这项多中心横断面诊断分类研究评估了Lumipulse血浆p-tau217在布鲁塞尔探索队列及巴黎、波尔多和单基因FTLD验证队列中的诊断表现。p-tau217对Aβ状态区分能力最佳（AUC 0.96），0.193 pg/mL截断值在多个队列中保持较高敏感度和特异度，且低于该值提示新皮质tau病变可能性低。双阈值产生的灰区可通过二线CSF检测大部分解决。值得注意的是，合并ALS的FTLD患者中假阳性分类富集，提示在ALS-FTLD谱系中解读p-tau217结果需谨慎。
items.insight: 虽然该研究聚焦阿尔茨海默病，但其对合并ALS的FTLD患者中p-tau217假阳性富集的发现，对ALS生物标志物研究具有直接警示意义：在ALS-FTLD连续谱中，血浆p-tau217可能反映共病理而非单纯AD，未来ALS生物标志物面板需纳入FTLD共病理分层。此外，该研究展示的跨中心阈值可转移性和灰区二线裁决策略，为ALS血液生物标志物（如神经丝轻链）的标准化落地提供了方法学参考。

aiRead.studyType: 多中心横断面诊断分类研究（探索性队列+3个外部验证队列）
aiRead.keyFinding: Lumipulse血浆p-tau217的0.193 pg/mL阈值在多个中心、分析仪、试剂批次和临床人群中可转移，对Aβ状态区分AUC达0.96；合并ALS的FTLD患者中假阳性分类富集。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计、仅限西欧专业化招募、缺乏种族/民族数据、参考标准异质性、单基因FTLD中AD共病理裁决不完整、无跨平台比较。

items.abstractZh: 血液生物标志物（BBMs），尤其是血浆苏氨酸217磷酸化tau蛋白（p-tau217），有望扩大阿尔茨海默病（AD）临床-生物学诊断的应用规模，但临床使用需要可在不同实验室和人群间转移的阈值。本研究将Lumipulse p-tau217与其他BBMs进行比较；评估以淀粉样蛋白为锚定的阈值在不同中心、分析仪、试剂批次和临床人群间的表现；并评估对灰区结果进行二线脑脊液（CSF）裁决的效果。这项多中心、横断面诊断分类研究包括一个探索性布鲁塞尔队列和3个外部验证队列。布鲁塞尔参与者认知正常或受损，其Aβ状态由淀粉样蛋白PET或CSF Aβ42确定，tau状态由tau-PET或CSF p-tau181确定。验证队列包括巴黎记忆门诊的连续患者、波尔多的早发性神经退行性痴呆患者以及单基因额颞叶变性（FTLD）个体。血浆p-tau217在本地Lumipulse分析仪上检测。使用受试者工作特征（ROC）分析比较BBMs及其比值。在布鲁塞尔队列中，推导了Youden截断值以及95%或97.5%敏感度/特异度双截断值；中间值定义为灰区。在411名参与者（平均年龄70.5岁；51.6%女性）中，p-tau217显示出最佳诊断性能；p-tau217/Aβ42比值未改善性能或减少灰区。在布鲁塞尔，p-tau217可区分Aβ+与Aβ-状态（AUC 0.96，95% CI 0.93-0.98；p < 0.0001）。0.193 pg/mL的Youden截断值（95% CI 0.178-0.213）产生91.5%敏感度（95% CI 84.7-95.5）和91.6%特异度（95% CI 84.8-95.5），并以98.5%敏感度和81.8%特异度检出新皮质tau-PET阳性。在巴黎，对临床-生物学AD的敏感度/特异度为93.2%（95% CI 85.1-97.1）/93.0%（95% CI 81.4-97.6）；在波尔多，对临床-生物学AD的敏感度/特异度为95.7%（95% CI 79.0-99.2）/92.3%（95% CI 66.7-98.6）。在单基因FTLD中特异度为88.4%（95% CI 75.5-94.9）。假阳性分类富集于合并肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的FTLD。双阈值在15.4%-24.8%的巴黎患者中产生灰区；二线CSF检测解决了86.2%-88.9%的灰区病例。Lumipulse血浆p-tau217阈值可在不同中心、分析仪、试剂批次和异质性临床人群间转移，支持评估血浆优先路径并对灰区值进行确认检测。低于0.193 pg/mL的值使新皮质tau病变不太可能。局限性包括横断面设计、西欧专业化招募、缺乏种族/民族数据、参考标准异质性、单基因FTLD中AD共病理裁决不完整以及无跨平台比较。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近证明血浆p-tau217阈值可跨实验室和人群转移，并首次系统描述合并ALS的FTLD中假阳性富集，对ALS-FTLD谱系的生物标志物解读和转化应用具有直接价值。

items.title: Health-Related Quality of Life Across Neurologic Conditions: A Cross-Sectional Cohort Study Using Real-World Patient-Reported Outcomes.
items.summary: Health-related quality of life (HRQOL) is an important outcome within value-based care for patients with neurologic conditions. The American Academy of Neurology recommends the use of Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System (PROMIS) Global Health as a patient-reported outcome performance measure to assess stability or improvement over 1 year. However, interpretation of this measure requires an understanding of HRQOL across neurologic populations. Our study leveraged real-world data collected through the electronic health record to characterize differences in HRQOL across common neurologic conditions. This is a cross-sectional study of adult patients with 1 of 10 conditions (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis [ALS], back pain, brain tumor, dementia, major depression, epilepsy, migraine, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson disease, and stroke) who completed patient-reported outcomes as standard care between October 2015 and March 2023 at a large Neurologic Institute. Patients completed PROMIS-GH, from which physical and mental summary scores (Global Mental Health [GMH], Global Physical Health [GPH]) were calculated, PHQ-9 depression screen, and condition-specific measures. EQ-5D utility index was estimated from PROMIS-GH. These were summarized across conditions after adjustment for demographics, clinical characteristics, and self-reported condition-specific severity. There were 133,636 patients included in this analysis (mean age 51.5 [SD ± 18] years, 64% female, 81% White race). Overall adjusted average scores for GPH, GMH, PHQ-9, and EQ-5D were 42.7 ± 5.0, 43.6 ± 5.0, 7.9 ± 3.7, and 0.68 ± 0.11, respectively. Scores were significantly different across condition, with GPH ranging from 39.6 ± 5.5 for back pain to 45.9 ± 3.9 for brain tumor. Patients with brain tumor, back pain, stroke, ALS, and multiple sclerosis had more favorable GMH and PHQ-9 scores, while patients with depression, epilepsy, and dementia had the most affected GMH and PHQ-9 scores. Patients with back pain and headache had the lowest EQ-5D scores (0.63 ± 0.13 and 0.67 ± 0.09), while those with brain tumor had the highest (0.77 ± 0.08). This study provides condition-specific and severity-specific benchmarks for PROMIS-GH and related HRQOL measures that can support interpretation of patient-reported outcomes across neurologic populations. These data inform clinical care, quality measurement, research, and the implementation of the AAN-recommended performance measure.
items.titleZh: 神经系统疾病中的健康相关生活质量：一项使用真实世界患者报告结局的横断面队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项横断面研究基于13万余例神经科患者的真实世界数据，建立了PROMIS全球健康等患者报告结局在10种神经系统疾病中的基准值。研究发现不同疾病间生活质量评分差异显著，ALS患者在某些心理健康指标上相对较好，但整体身体功能受损明显。这些基准有助于解读ALS患者的报告结局并支持质量评估。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS提供了基于大样本真实世界数据的HRQOL基准，有助于在临床研究和质量改进中更准确地解读PROMIS等患者报告结局，避免因缺乏参照而误判干预效果。

aiRead.studyType: 横断面队列研究（观察性）
aiRead.keyFinding: 不同神经系统疾病间PROMIS-GH等HRQOL评分差异显著，研究提供了疾病特异性和严重程度特异性的基准值，包括ALS患者的数据。
aiRead.limitation: 横断面设计无法推断因果关系；样本以白人、女性为主，可能限制泛化性；未报告ALS亚组的具体评分细节。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注基于这些基准的纵向研究，以及PROMIS-GH在ALS临床试验中作为结局指标的验证和应用。

items.abstractZh: 健康相关生活质量（HRQOL）是神经系统疾病患者价值医疗中的重要结局。美国神经病学学会推荐使用患者报告结局测量信息系统（PROMIS）全球健康量表作为患者报告结局绩效指标，以评估1年内的稳定性或改善情况。然而，解读该指标需要了解不同神经病人群的HRQOL。本研究利用通过电子健康记录收集的真实世界数据，描述常见神经系统疾病间HRQOL的差异。这是一项横断面研究，纳入2015年10月至2023年3月期间在一家大型神经病学研究所作为标准护理完成患者报告结局的成人患者，涵盖10种疾病之一（肌萎缩侧索硬化[ALS]、背痛、脑肿瘤、痴呆、重度抑郁、癫痫、偏头痛、多发性硬化、帕金森病和卒中）。患者完成PROMIS-GH，并计算身体和心理健康总结评分（全球心理健康[GMH]、全球身体健康[GPH]）、PHQ-9抑郁筛查和疾病特异性量表。EQ-5D效用指数由PROMIS-GH估算。在调整人口学特征、临床特征和自我报告的疾病特异性严重程度后，对这些指标按疾病进行汇总。共纳入133,636例患者（平均年龄51.5[SD ± 18]岁，64%女性，81%白人）。GPH、GMH、PHQ-9和EQ-5D的总体调整平均分分别为42.7 ± 5.0、43.6 ± 5.0、7.9 ± 3.7和0.68 ± 0.11。不同疾病间评分存在显著差异，GPH范围从背痛的39.6 ± 5.5到脑肿瘤的45.9 ± 3.9。脑肿瘤、背痛、卒中、ALS和多发性硬化患者的GMH和PHQ-9评分更有利，而抑郁、癫痫和痴呆患者的GMH和PHQ-9评分受影响最大。背痛和头痛患者的EQ-5D评分最低（0.63 ± 0.13和0.67 ± 0.09），脑肿瘤患者最高（0.77 ± 0.08）。本研究提供了PROMIS-GH及相关HRQOL指标的疾病特异性和严重程度特异性基准，可支持跨神经病人群患者报告结局的解读。这些数据为临床护理、质量测量、研究和AAN推荐绩效指标的实施提供信息。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究新近建立了跨神经疾病（包括ALS）的真实世界HRQOL基准，对推动患者报告结局在ALS临床研究和价值医疗中的标准化应用具有转化价值。

items.title: Sephin1 protects from glutamate stress, consistent with negative allosteric modulation of GluN2B-containing NMDA receptor.
items.summary: Glutamate excitotoxicity and GluN2B containing N-methyl-d-aspartate receptors (NMDARs) are involved in neurodegenerative diseases such as Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis, Parkinson disease and Alzheimer disease. Recently, Sephin1, a first-in-class, multi-functional, brain-penetrant, orally administered small molecule, has been demonstrated in vitro to improve motor neurons survival following glutamate intoxication. In ALS animal models, Sephin1 was able to reduce motor neuron loss, to improve motor function and increase animal survival. To determine how Sephin1 can reduce motor neurons loss following glutamate intoxication, calcium flux was measured in primary cortical neurons and in GluN1A/GluN2B overexpressing cells following NMDA stimulation. Then, to determine the binding site on GluN1 and GluN2B subunits, binding assays were performed with three benzylideneaminoguanidine derivatives, Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048. Here, for the first time, we show that Sephin1 reduces calcium flux in NMDA stimulated primary cortical neurons in a dose dependent manner. Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048 reduce the rise of calcium flux in GluN1A/GluN2B subunits overexpressing cells stimulated with NMDA. In addition, we demonstrated that Sephin1, guanabenz and IFB-048, displace ifenprodil from the N-terminal domain (NTD) of NMDAR (GluN1/GluN2B) containing the polyamine site on GluN2B subunits. The three benzylideneaminoguanidine derivatives could possibly be Negative Allosteric Modulator (NAM) of GluN2B-containing NMDARs.
items.titleZh: Sephin1 对谷氨酸应激具有保护作用，与含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体负向变构调节一致
items.summaryZh: 该研究在细胞层面探索 Sephin1 保护运动神经元免受谷氨酸毒性的机制。结果显示，Sephin1 可剂量依赖性地降低 NMDA 刺激引起的原代皮层神经元钙内流，并在过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞中减弱钙流升高；Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 均可从含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体 N 端结构域置换艾芬地尔。作者据此提出，这些苄叉氨基胍衍生物可能是含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体的负向变构调节剂。
items.insight: 该研究为 Sephin1 在 ALS 模型中的神经保护作用提供了可能的分子机制解释，即通过含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体负向变构调节减少谷氨酸兴奋性毒性。对关注谷氨酸兴奋性毒性通路和 Sephin1 转化研究的 ALS 研究者而言，这一机制线索值得跟踪，但当前证据来自细胞实验，尚不能推断临床疗效。

aiRead.studyType: 体外细胞机制研究（原代皮层神经元及过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞）
aiRead.keyFinding: Sephin1 剂量依赖性降低 NMDA 诱导的神经元钙流，并与胍那苄、IFB-048 一样从含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR N 端结构域置换艾芬地尔，提示其为含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR 负向变构调节剂。
aiRead.limitation: 证据限于细胞层面，未提供临床或体内直接验证；结合位点和变构调节结论仍需进一步结构生物学和功能实验确认。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注 Sephin1 在 ALS 动物模型中的靶点验证、GluN2B 选择性以及向临床转化所需的药理学和安全性数据。

items.abstractZh: 谷氨酸兴奋性毒性和含 GluN2B 的 N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体（NMDAR）参与肌萎缩侧索硬化、帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病等神经退行性疾病。近期，Sephin1——一种首创、多功能、可透过血脑屏障、可口服的小分子——已在体外被证明可改善谷氨酸中毒后的运动神经元存活。在 ALS 动物模型中，Sephin1 能够减少运动神经元丢失、改善运动功能并提高动物生存率。为确定 Sephin1 如何减少谷氨酸中毒后的运动神经元丢失，研究者在原代皮层神经元和过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 的细胞中，于 NMDA 刺激后测量了钙流。随后，为确定其在 GluN1 和 GluN2B 亚基上的结合位点，研究者用三种苄叉氨基胍衍生物——Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048——进行了结合实验。本文首次显示，Sephin1 以剂量依赖方式降低 NMDA 刺激的原代皮层神经元中的钙流。Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可降低 NMDA 刺激的过表达 GluN1A/GluN2B 亚基细胞中钙流的升高。此外，我们证明 Sephin1、胍那苄和 IFB-048 可将艾芬地尔从含 GluN2B 亚基上多胺位点的 NMDAR（GluN1/GluN2B）N 端结构域（NTD）置换出来。这三种苄叉氨基胍衍生物可能是含 GluN2B 的 NMDAR 的负向变构调节剂（NAM）。
items.frontierRationale: 新近细胞研究首次将 Sephin1 的神经保护作用与含 GluN2B 的 NMDA 受体负向变构调节联系起来，对 ALS 谷氨酸兴奋性毒性机制和药物转化具有参考价值。

items.title: Limited contribution of natural killer cells to SOD1 G93A ALS pathogenesis: evidence from comprehensive immunophenotyping and genetic deletion of Ncr1 and Properdin .
items.summary: Immune dysregulation contributes to amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) pathogenesis. Natural killer (NK) lymphocytes have been proposed to contribute to ALS, but their exact role remains debated. Here we combined comprehensive immunophenotyping strategy with two complementary loss-of-function approaches to trace NK cells and assess their Ncr1-associated cytotoxic function in SOD1 G93A mice. We found no significant difference in the proportion, maturation, and activation status of circulating NK cells between control and SOD1 G93A mice at onset and symptomatic stage, and no significant NK cell recruitment to the central nervous system at any disease stage. Notably, resident microglia in the SOD1 G93A spinal cord acquire NK1.1 expression at the symptomatic stage. NK cells isolated from SOD1 G93A mice did not affect motoneuron survival in vitro . We further show that genetic deletion of Ncr1 , which abolishes one of the major activating pathways of NK-cell cytotoxicity, did not modify disease onset, motor function or survival of SOD1 G93A mice. Additionally, we show that Properdin, a positive regulator of the alternative complement pathway and a reported ligand of NCR1, decorates misfolded SOD1 inclusions and degenerating astrocytes, consistent with a role as a phagocytic signal for CD68 + microglia. However, genetic deletion of Properdin in SOD1 G93A did not influence neuroinflammation or motoneuron survival. Together, the unchanged frequency, maturation or activation status of NK cells, combined with the lack of effect of Ncr1 genetic ablation argue against a major NK contribution to motoneuron degeneration in the SOD1 G93A mouse model, while uncovering an unexpected role for Properdin in opsonizing misfolded SOD1 aggregates.
items.titleZh: 自然杀伤细胞对SOD1 G93A ALS发病机制的贡献有限：来自全面免疫表型分析和Ncr1与Properdin基因缺失的证据
items.summaryZh: 该研究在SOD1 G93A ALS小鼠模型中系统追踪NK细胞，发现其数量、成熟度、活化状态及向中枢神经系统的募集均无显著变化；敲除NK细胞主要活化受体Ncr1不影响疾病发病、运动功能或生存；体外NK细胞也不影响运动神经元存活。研究还发现补体调控因子Properdin可标记错误折叠SOD1包涵体和退变星形胶质细胞，但敲除Properdin同样不影响神经炎症或运动神经元存活。总体结果不支持NK细胞在该模型中对运动神经元变性起主要作用。
items.insight: 这项研究对“NK细胞驱动ALS运动神经元损伤”的假说提供了较为系统的反证，有助于研究者把免疫干预靶点从NK细胞细胞毒性转向小胶质细胞吞噬信号或补体调理等方向；同时Properdin标记错误折叠SOD1的发现提示补体-吞噬轴值得在ALS中进一步追踪。

aiRead.studyType: 动物/细胞实验（SOD1 G93A小鼠模型，结合免疫表型分析及Ncr1、Properdin基因敲除）
aiRead.keyFinding: NK细胞比例、成熟度、活化及中枢募集无显著变化，Ncr1或Properdin基因敲除均未改变SOD1 G93A小鼠疾病进程；Properdin可标记错误折叠SOD1包涵体和退变星形胶质细胞。
aiRead.limitation: 研究仅基于SOD1 G93A小鼠模型和体外实验，不能直接外推至人类ALS或其他遗传亚型；NK细胞作用被否定不等于所有固有免疫通路均无贡献。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续可关注Properdin-补体-小胶质细胞吞噬轴在ALS中的功能验证，以及在其他ALS模型或人源样本中NK细胞作用的独立重复研究。

items.abstractZh: 免疫失调参与肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的发病机制。自然杀伤（NK）淋巴细胞被认为可能参与ALS，但其确切作用仍存争议。本研究将全面的免疫表型分析策略与两种互补的功能缺失方法相结合，以追踪SOD1 G93A小鼠中的NK细胞并评估其与Ncr1相关的细胞毒功能。我们发现，在发病期和症状期，对照小鼠与SOD1 G93A小鼠之间循环NK细胞的比例、成熟度和活化状态均无显著差异，且在任何疾病阶段均未观察到NK细胞向中枢神经系统的显著募集。值得注意的是，SOD1 G93A小鼠脊髓中的驻留小胶质细胞在症状期获得NK1.1表达。从SOD1 G93A小鼠分离的NK细胞在体外不影响运动神经元存活。我们进一步表明，基因敲除Ncr1（该基因敲除消除了NK细胞细胞毒性的主要激活通路之一）并未改变SOD1 G93A小鼠的疾病发病、运动功能或生存。此外，我们还表明，Properdin（替代补体通路的正调控因子，也是已被报道的NCR1配体）装饰错误折叠的SOD1包涵体和退变星形胶质细胞，这与它作为CD68+小胶质细胞吞噬信号的作用一致。然而，在SOD1 G93A中基因敲除Properdin并未影响神经炎症或运动神经元存活。总之，NK细胞频率、成熟度或活化状态未发生变化，加上Ncr1基因消融缺乏效应，这些结果不支持NK细胞对SOD1 G93A小鼠模型中的运动神经元变性有主要贡献，同时揭示了Properdin在调理错误折叠SOD1聚集体中的意外作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究以免疫表型分析和双基因敲除在SOD1 G93A小鼠中系统检验NK细胞作用，并新近揭示Properdin调理错误折叠SOD1聚集体的潜在转化线索。

items.title: Microglial perturbation in heavy metal-induced neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration: mechanisms, phenotypic plasticity, and therapeutic prospects.
items.summary: Heavy metal exposure has emerged as a significant environmental contributor to neurodegenerative disease, and a substantial body of mechanistic evidence implicates microglia in the pathological cascades that follow. Lead, cadmium, arsenic, manganese, copper, cobalt, mercury, and zinc disrupt central nervous system homeostasis through multiple cellular targets, but the resident innate immune cells of the brain are well placed to translate these insults into sustained neuroinflammation. Evidence for this critical narrative review was assembled through a purposive search of PubMed, MEDLINE, and Google Scholar for mechanistically informative studies reporting glial endpoints, with reference lists searched by hand and no systematic protocol applied. This review synthesizes current understanding of how individual metals engage microglial signaling networks, with particular attention to oxidative stress, NF-κB activation, NLRP3 inflammasome assembly, MAPK cascades, and suppression of the Nrf2 antioxidant axis. We examine the phenotypic spectrum that extends well beyond the classical M1/M2 dichotomy, including disease-associated microglia, lipid-droplet-accumulating microglia, and interferon-responsive states, and consider how metal-specific signatures map onto these transcriptional programs. Manganese-driven inflammasome assembly, cadmium-induced mitochondrial impairment, lead-mediated disruption of calcium homeostasis, and mercury-evoked autophagic dysfunction are discussed as illustrative examples of mechanistic divergence within a common neuroinflammatory framework. Glial responses to metal mixtures, which better represent real exposure than single-element designs, are considered separately, and the evidence for greater-than-additive effects is appraised. Downstream consequences for astrocyte reactivity, blood-brain barrier integrity, synaptic remodeling, and neuronal viability are placed in the context of Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Therapeutic avenues are appraised, including chelation, natural antioxidants, NLRP3 inhibitors, TREM2 modulation, and microglial replacement strategies. Methodological constraints, particularly the overreliance on BV-2 cells and acute high-dose exposure paradigms, are critically considered. The review concludes by identifying priorities for translational research, including longitudinal human cohort studies, single-cell transcriptomic profiling of metal-exposed microglia, and the development of region-specific exposure models that better reflect chronic environmental realities.

items.titleZh: 重金属诱导的神经炎症与神经退行性变中的小胶质细胞扰动：机制、表型可塑性与治疗前景
items.summaryZh: 这是一篇叙述性综述，系统梳理铅、镉、砷、锰、铜、钴、汞、锌等重金属如何通过氧化应激、NF-κB、NLRP3炎症小体、MAPK和Nrf2等通路扰动小胶质细胞，进而推动神经炎症和神经退行性变。文章强调小胶质细胞表型远不止M1/M2，还涉及疾病相关小胶质细胞、脂滴蓄积型和干扰素反应状态，并将下游后果联系到阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和ALS。治疗方面讨论了螯合、抗氧化剂、NLRP3抑制剂、TREM2调节和小胶质细胞替代等策略，同时指出当前研究过度依赖BV-2细胞和急性高剂量模型等局限。
items.insight: 该综述把环境重金属暴露、小胶质细胞状态异质性与ALS等神经退行性疾病联系起来，为理解ALS中神经炎症的环境驱动因素提供了整合框架。其提出的单细胞转录组、纵向人群队列和区域特异性慢性暴露模型，正是ALS环境病因学研究亟需补足的短板；TREM2调节和小胶质细胞替代策略也与当前ALS神经免疫治疗方向直接相关。

items.abstractZh: 重金属暴露已成为神经退行性疾病的重要环境贡献因素，大量机制性证据表明小胶质细胞参与其后的病理级联反应。铅、镉、砷、锰、铜、钴、汞和锌通过多种细胞靶点破坏中枢神经系统稳态，但脑内驻留的固有免疫细胞处于将这些损伤转化为持续性神经炎症的关键位置。本叙述性综述的证据通过针对PubMed、MEDLINE和Google Scholar的目的性检索汇集，纳入报告胶质终点的机制性信息研究，并手工检索参考文献列表，未采用系统化方案。本综述综合了当前关于各金属如何介入小胶质细胞信号网络的认识，特别关注氧化应激、NF-κB激活、NLRP3炎症小体组装、MAPK级联以及Nrf2抗氧化轴的抑制。我们考察了远超经典M1/M2二分法的表型谱，包括疾病相关小胶质细胞、脂滴蓄积型小胶质细胞和干扰素反应状态，并探讨金属特异性特征如何映射到这些转录程序。锰驱动的炎症小体组装、镉诱导的线粒体损伤、铅介导的钙稳态破坏以及汞引发的自噬功能障碍，作为共同神经炎症框架内机制分歧的示例加以讨论。金属混合物的胶质反应（比单元素设计更接近真实暴露）单独讨论，并评估了超加性效应的证据。对星形胶质细胞反应性、血脑屏障完整性、突触重塑和神经元存活的下游后果，置于阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症的背景下讨论。评估的治疗途径包括螯合、天然抗氧化剂、NLRP3抑制剂、TREM2调节和小胶质细胞替代策略。方法学局限，特别是过度依赖BV-2细胞和急性高剂量暴露范式，受到批判性审视。综述最后确定了转化研究的优先方向，包括纵向人类队列研究、金属暴露小胶质细胞的单细胞转录组分析，以及开发更能反映慢性环境现实的区域特异性暴露模型。
items.frontierRationale: 该综述新近整合了重金属暴露下小胶质细胞表型可塑性与ALS等疾病的关联，并明确提出单细胞转录组和慢性暴露模型等转化研究优先方向，对ALS环境病因与神经炎症研究具有参考价值。

items.title: Physical exercise interventions for people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a systematic review with meta-analysis.
items.summary: This systematic review with meta-analysis examines the efficacy of specific exercise modalities for people with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). Comprehensive searches were conducted in PubMed, Cochrane, Scopus, Web of Science, Embase, PEDro, and Scielo databases for randomized controlled trials involving exercise in people with ALS. Interventions were classified using FITT-VP (frequency-intensity-type-time-volume-progression) principles and the American College of Sports Medicine guidelines. Risk of bias and methodological quality were assessed using the RoB2 and the PEDro scale. Random-effect meta-analyses were conducted to estimate pooled effect sizes, with 95% confidence and prediction intervals. 15 studies were included ( n = 595). Meta-analyses showed non-significant effects on functional capacity for resistance (SMD = 0.258; 95%CI: -0.578 to 1.095; favoring exercise), cardiovascular (MD = -1.677; 95%CI: -11.224 to 7.871; favoring control), and concurrent training (MD = 5.573; 95%CI: -6.095 to 17.242; favoring exercise). Respiratory training did not significantly improve inspiratory pressure (SMD = 0.42; 95%CI: -0.18 to 1.03; favoring exercise). High adherence (82%) and comparable adverse events confirmed safety. Substantial heterogeneity and low certainty of evidence preclude the establishment of solid clinical conclusions. Exercise appears safe and well tolerated in people with ALS, but specific clinical efficacy remains unconfirmed. CRD420251161766. Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurological disease that causes muscle weakness and rapid functional decline. Exercise is often suggested to support physical function and well-being, but its real benefits and safety have been unclear. In this study, we reviewed 15 clinical trials involving 595 people with ALS to assess the effects of different exercise programs, including strength training, aerobic exercise, combined programs, and breathing exercises.Overall, current evidence does not show statistically significant differences in disease progression or functional decline when comparing exercise to standard care. However, exercise was found to be very safe, feasible, and well tolerated, with high completion rates and no increase in serious adverse events. In addition, patients who participated in exercise programs often experienced positive effects on quality of life and psychological well-being. Several studies that included younger patients or those in earlier disease stages showed better adaptations to exercise.In conclusion, exercise is safe and does not accelerate ALS progression. Future research needs to better define individual patient characteristics and exercise doses to help clinicians prescribe personalized, effective training programs.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的体育锻炼干预：一项系统综述与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 该系统综述与荟萃分析纳入15项随机对照试验（共595例ALS患者），评估抗阻、心血管、并行及呼吸训练等运动方式的效果。结果显示，各运动方式对功能能力或吸气压力的改善均未达到统计学显著差异，但运动总体安全、耐受良好，依从性高（82%），严重不良事件未增加。部分研究提示较年轻或疾病早期患者可能对运动适应性更好。由于异质性大、证据确定性低，尚无法得出确切的临床疗效结论。
items.insight: 这项荟萃分析为ALS运动干预的安全性提供了较全面的证据汇总，有助于临床医生在缺乏确切疗效证据的情况下仍可谨慎推荐运动，同时提示未来试验需按疾病分期、运动剂量（FITT-VP）进行分层设计，对ALS临床试验设计和康复指南制定具有参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 抗阻、心血管、并行训练对功能能力及呼吸训练对吸气压力均无统计学显著改善，但运动安全、耐受良好、依从性高（82%），严重不良事件未增加。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注按疾病分期和FITT-VP运动剂量分层的后续随机对照试验，以及针对早期ALS患者个性化运动处方的疗效验证研究。

items.abstractZh: 本系统综述与荟萃分析考察了特定运动方式对肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）患者的疗效。研究在PubMed、Cochrane、Scopus、Web of Science、Embase、PEDro和Scielo数据库中全面检索了涉及ALS患者运动的随机对照试验。干预措施依据FITT-VP（频率-强度-类型-时间-总量-进阶）原则和美国运动医学会指南进行分类。采用RoB2和PEDro量表评估偏倚风险和方法学质量。进行随机效应荟萃分析以估计合并效应量，并计算95%置信区间和预测区间。共纳入15项研究（n=595）。荟萃分析显示，抗阻训练（SMD=0.258；95%CI：-0.578至1.095；倾向于运动）、心血管训练（MD=-1.677；95%CI：-11.224至7.871；倾向于对照）和并行训练（MD=5.573；95%CI：-6.095至17.242；倾向于运动）对功能能力的影响均无统计学意义。呼吸训练未显著改善吸气压力（SMD=0.42；95%CI：-0.18至1.03；倾向于运动）。高依从性（82%）和相当的不良事件确认了安全性。显著的异质性和低证据确定性妨碍了得出可靠的临床结论。运动在ALS患者中似乎是安全且耐受良好的，但具体临床疗效仍未得到证实。CRD420251161766。肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性神经系统疾病，导致肌肉无力和功能快速衰退。通常建议通过运动来支持身体功能和健康，但其实际获益和安全性尚不明确。在本研究中，我们回顾了涉及595名ALS患者的15项临床试验，以评估不同运动方案的效果，包括力量训练、有氧运动、联合方案和呼吸练习。总体而言，当前证据未显示运动与标准护理相比在疾病进展或功能衰退方面存在统计学显著差异。然而，研究发现运动非常安全、可行且耐受良好，完成率高且严重不良事件未增加。此外，参与运动方案的患者常报告生活质量和心理幸福感方面的积极效果。一些纳入较年轻患者或疾病早期阶段患者的研究显示对运动的适应性更好。总之，运动是安全的，不会加速ALS进展。未来研究需要更好地界定个体患者特征和运动剂量，以帮助临床医生制定个性化、有效的训练方案。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究于2026年发表，系统整合了ALS运动干预的最新随机对照证据，明确了运动的安全性与疗效不确定性，为后续个性化运动处方的转化研究提供了方向。

items.title: Matching biomarkers to their context of use in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis clinical trials: how much evidence is enough?
items.summary: Biomarkers increasingly inform drug development and regulatory decisions in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), but the evidence appropriate for each context of use (COU) is not consistently articulated. Building on the FDA-NIH Biomarkers, EndpointS, and other Tools (BEST) resource and existing qualification and surrogate endpoint frameworks, we propose an ALS COU framework linking decisions, supporting evidence and consequences of error. Six named descriptors distinguish analytical validity, association, prospective prognostic validation, pharmacodynamic response, within-mechanism concordance and cross-mechanism generalizability. We define what mechanism means for this purpose, set out the evidence a single development programme can provide, and apply the framework to six trial programmes and to discovery-stage fluid, neurophysiological and imaging candidates. A protocol checklist is provided. Evidence should be judged for a stated decision rather than for a biomarker in general. Neurofilament light chain supports prospective prognostic use and a pharmacodynamic response to SOD1-lowering therapy, but trial-level surrogate validation remains unestablished in ALS, and whether it is attainable depends on how narrowly mechanism is defined. Explicit protocol statements, pre-specified within-programme analyses and internationally shared expectations could support proportionate use while preserving regulatory flexibility.
items.titleZh: 将生物标志物与其在肌萎缩侧索硬化临床试验中的使用场景相匹配：多少证据才算足够？
items.summaryZh: 该专家综述提出一个ALS生物标志物使用场景（COU）框架，用六个描述符区分从分析有效性到跨机制可推广性的不同证据层级，强调证据应针对具体决策评判。作者将该框架应用于六个试验项目及发现阶段的候选标志物，并指出神经丝轻链（NfL）目前可支持前瞻性预后和SOD1降低疗法的药效学反应，但作为试验层面替代终点尚未在ALS中验证。
items.insight: 随着ALS试验越来越多地使用NfL等生物标志物作为入组、分层或药效学指标，如何界定“证据足够”直接影响监管接受度和试验设计。该框架为研究者提供了可操作的方案清单和证据分级语言，有助于在后续SOD1及其他机制试验中预先规范生物标志物用途，避免将药效学反应误读为替代终点。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注该框架是否被后续ALS试验方案采纳，以及NfL作为替代终点的验证研究能否在特定机制定义下推进。

items.abstractZh: 生物标志物在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）的药物开发和监管决策中日益发挥重要作用，但适用于每种使用场景（COU）的证据并未得到一致阐述。基于FDA-NIH生物标志物、终点及其他工具（BEST）资源以及现有的资格认定和替代终点框架，我们提出了一个ALS COU框架，将决策、支持性证据和错误后果联系起来。六个命名描述符区分了分析有效性、关联性、前瞻性预后验证、药效学反应、机制内一致性和跨机制可推广性。我们为此目的定义了机制的含义，阐述了单个开发项目所能提供的证据，并将该框架应用于六个试验项目以及发现阶段的体液、神经生理和影像候选标志物。提供了一份方案清单。证据应针对特定决策而非泛泛地针对某一生物标志物进行评判。神经丝轻链支持前瞻性预后用途以及对SOD1降低疗法的药效学反应，但试验层面的替代终点验证在ALS中仍未确立，其是否可实现取决于机制定义的宽窄程度。明确的方案陈述、预先设定的项目内分析和国际共享的期望可支持相称的使用，同时保留监管灵活性。
items.frontierRationale: 该文于2026年提出面向ALS临床试验的生物标志物使用场景分级框架，直接回应NfL等标志物在监管决策中证据标准不清的转化瓶颈。

items.title: Machado-Joseph Disease with Bilateral Upper Limb Muscle Atrophy and Widespread Fasciculations: A Case Report.
items.summary: Machado-Joseph disease (MJD) is an autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia that presents with various neurological manifestations. We herein report a case of a 63-year-old woman who had previously been suspected of having amyotrophic lateral sclerosis but was subsequently confirmed to have MJD through genetic testing. She exhibited prominent bilateral upper limb muscle atrophy and weakness, thus raising suspicion of flail arm syndrome. In addition, needle electromyography revealed widespread fasciculations. Nerve conduction studies revealed sensorimotor neuropathy, and magnetic resonance imaging showed cerebellar atrophy. This report highlights the significance of recognizing atypical clinical manifestations of MJD for appropriate diagnosis and management.
items.titleZh: 马查多-约瑟夫病伴双上肢肌肉萎缩及广泛肌束颤动：一例病例报告
items.summaryZh: 本文报告一例63岁女性，因双上肢明显肌肉萎缩、无力和广泛肌束颤动，曾被怀疑为肌萎缩侧索硬化或连枷臂综合征，最终通过基因检测确诊为马查多-约瑟夫病（MJD）。检查还发现感觉运动神经病和小脑萎缩。作者强调，MJD可表现出类似ALS的不典型症状，识别这些表现有助于正确诊断。
items.insight: 该病例提示，表现为上肢肌肉萎缩和广泛肌束颤动的患者不一定就是ALS，MJD等遗传性共济失调也可出现类似下运动神经元受累的表现。对ALS研究者而言，这强调了在非典型病例中纳入遗传学鉴别诊断（尤其是SCA3/MJD）的重要性，以避免误诊并指导遗传咨询。

aiRead.keyFinding: 一例曾被怀疑为ALS的63岁女性，经基因检测确诊为MJD，表现为双上肢肌肉萎缩、无力和广泛肌束颤动，类似连枷臂综合征。

items.title: Recent Advances in the Role of Selenoproteins in Neurodegenerative Diseases.
items.summary: The central nervous system (CNS) is particularly susceptible to oxidative stress owing to its elevated oxygen (O 2 ) consumption, limited antioxidant defense, abundant lipid content, and relatively low regenerative capacity. Oxidative stress is a common denominator between various neurodegenerative diseases (NDs), including Alzheimer's disease (AD), Parkinson's disease (PD), Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), and Huntington's disease (HD), where the antioxidant system becomes ineffective. In this context, selenoproteins play a pivotal role in mitigating oxidative damage in neurons and maintaining redox homeostasis. Moreover, mounting evidence has indicated that decreased levels of several selenoproteins are linked to age-related NDs. The human genome contains 25 selenoproteins that act as key antioxidant enzymes, including glutathione peroxidases (GPXs) and thioredoxin reductases (TXNRDs), which neutralize hydrogen peroxide (H 2 O 2 ) and lipid peroxide and regulate thiol-dependent redox signaling. In addition to this classical antioxidant defense, other categories of selenoproteins provide direct neuroprotective actions through various mechanisms related to NDs. Endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-resident selenoproteins such as selenoprotein T (SELENOT), selenoprotein M (SELENOM), and selenoprotein S (SELENOS) that contribute to protein quality control, Ca 2+ homeostasis and ER stress prevention are emerging as valuable targets in NDs. Nevertheless, the mechanisms underlying the beneficial effects of selenoproteins in the nervous system are not fully elucidated and require extensive research to pave the way to the application of these antioxidant proteins in NDs therapies.
items.titleZh: 硒蛋白在神经退行性疾病中作用的最新进展
items.summaryZh: 该综述指出，中枢神经系统因高耗氧、抗氧化防御有限和脂质丰富而易受氧化应激损伤，氧化应激是阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和亨廷顿病的共同病理环节。硒蛋白（人类基因组共25种）通过谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶和硫氧还蛋白还原酶等中和过氧化氢和脂质过氧化物，维持氧化还原稳态；内质网驻留的SELENOT、SELENOM和SELENOS还参与蛋白质质量控制、钙稳态和内质网应激预防。多种硒蛋白水平下降与年龄相关神经退行性疾病相关，但具体机制尚未完全阐明，距离治疗应用仍有距离。
items.insight: 该综述将硒蛋白的经典抗氧化功能与内质网驻留成员的非经典神经保护机制并列梳理，为ALS研究者提供了一个可操作的候选靶点清单（GPXs、TXNRDs、SELENOT/M/S）。在ALS中氧化应激与内质网应激均被反复牵涉，理解这两条通路的交汇点有助于筛选生物标志物和干预节点；同时作者明确承认机制未明，提示当前不宜过度解读为治疗证据。

items.abstractZh: 中枢神经系统（CNS）由于氧（O2）消耗量高、抗氧化防御能力有限、脂质含量丰富以及再生能力相对较低，特别容易受到氧化应激的影响。氧化应激是多种神经退行性疾病（NDs）之间的共同特征，包括阿尔茨海默病（AD）、帕金森病（PD）、肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）和亨廷顿病（HD），在这些疾病中抗氧化系统变得无效。在此背景下，硒蛋白在减轻神经元氧化损伤和维持氧化还原稳态方面发挥关键作用。此外，越来越多的证据表明，几种硒蛋白水平降低与年龄相关的神经退行性疾病有关。人类基因组包含25种硒蛋白，它们作为关键抗氧化酶发挥作用，包括谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（GPXs）和硫氧还蛋白还原酶（TXNRDs），可中和过氧化氢（H2O2）和脂质过氧化物，并调节硫醇依赖性氧化还原信号传导。除了这种经典的抗氧化防御外，其他类别的硒蛋白通过多种与神经退行性疾病相关的机制提供直接的神经保护作用。内质网（ER）驻留的硒蛋白，如硒蛋白T（SELENOT）、硒蛋白M（SELENOM）和硒蛋白S（SELENOS），有助于蛋白质质量控制、Ca2+稳态和预防内质网应激，正成为神经退行性疾病中有价值的靶点。然而，硒蛋白在神经系统中发挥有益作用的机制尚未完全阐明，需要广泛研究，为这些抗氧化蛋白在神经退行性疾病治疗中的应用铺平道路。
items.frontierRationale: 系统整合了硒蛋白在包括ALS在内的神经退行性疾病中抗氧化与内质网保护双重机制的最新认识，为氧化应激相关靶点研究提供转化线索。

items.title: Blood transcriptome analysis nominated altered gene expression in spliceosome machinery and innate immunity in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a devastating neurodegenerative disease characterized pathologically by nuclear depletion and cytoplasmic mislocalization of TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43), which are associated with RNA mis-splicing events in neuronal genes. Transcriptomic studies have identified ALS-related molecular signatures in both peripheral blood and central nervous system tissues. However, transcriptomic alterations in Chinese ALS cohorts remain incompletely characterized, and the contribution of small nuclear RNAs (snRNAs), essential components of the spliceosome, remains largely unexplored. Here, we profiled the expression of protein-coding genes and snRNAs in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 159 Chinese patients with ALS and 30 controls. We identified 207 upregulated and 980 downregulated genes in ALS, with the enrichment of multiple biological pathways. Notably, ALS-associated differentially expressed genes showed the activation of innate immunity and dysregulation of spliceosome machinery, including reduced expression of several U1 snRNA family members, such as RNU1-4, RNVU1-28, RNVU1-2A, RNVU1-31, RNU1-1, RNVU1-18, RNVU1-15 and RNVU1-7, accompanied by altered 5' splice-site recognition. Increased expression of candidate immune genes, including RNASE4, PGLYRP1, MMP9, FCGR3B and OLR1 were validated in an external ALS blood transcriptomic dataset. Together, these findings provide further evidence that innate immune-related transcriptional changes may represent a recurrent feature of ALS across populations, and may implicate snRNA dysregulation as a potential contributor to RNA-processing abnormalities in ALS.

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种毁灭性神经退行性疾病，病理上以TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）的核内耗竭和胞质错误定位为特征，这些与神经元基因的RNA错误剪接事件相关。转录组研究已在外周血和中枢神经系统组织中识别出ALS相关分子特征。然而，中国ALS队列的转录组改变仍未被充分表征，小核RNA（snRNA）——剪接体的重要组分——的作用在很大程度上尚未被探索。本研究分析了159例中国ALS患者和30例对照者外周血单核细胞中蛋白编码基因和snRNA的表达。我们在ALS中识别出207个上调基因和980个下调基因，并富集到多条生物学通路。值得注意的是，ALS相关差异表达基因显示先天免疫激活和剪接体机器失调，包括多个U1 snRNA家族成员表达降低，如RNU1-4、RNVU1-28、RNVU1-2A、RNVU1-31、RNU1-1、RNVU1-18、RNVU1-15和RNVU1-7，并伴随5'剪接位点识别改变。候选免疫基因RNASE4、PGLYRP1、MMP9、FCGR3B和OLR1的表达升高在外部ALS血液转录组数据集中得到验证。总之，这些发现进一步提供证据表明先天免疫相关转录改变可能是跨人群ALS的反复出现特征，并可能提示snRNA失调是ALS中RNA加工异常的潜在促成因素。
items.frontierRationale: 新近在中国ALS队列中揭示U1 snRNA下调与先天免疫激活并存，为ALS的RNA加工异常和跨人群外周标志物研究提供了转化线索。

items.title: Current rehabilitation approaches in ALS/MND and use of digital health technology; an international survey of occupational therapists and physiotherapists.
items.summary: Occupational Therapists (OTs) and Physiotherapists (PTs) provide rehabilitation at all stages of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS)/motor neurone disease (MND), but research is limited on current rehabilitation practice. In particular, little is known about digital health technology use, which is increasingly available in healthcare. This international online survey investigated current rehabilitation practices and digital health technology use among OTs and PTs. A 46-question survey consisting of open- and closed-ended questions targeted OTs and PTs through professional bodies, special interest groups, and social media. Questions explored symptom management, treatment strategies, and digital health technology use in ALS/MND. Quantitative data were analyzed primarily using descriptive statistics, while open-ended questions were qualitatively analyzed using thematic analysis. There were 240 responses from 16 countries (OTs = 85; PTs = 155). Respondents worked in ALS/MND for a median of 8 years (IQR 11). Fatigue (61.3%) and spasticity (45%) were the top symptoms often/always managed by respondents. OTs more frequently managed cognition, with PTs more frequently managing cough and secretions, pain, and prescribed exercise (stretches, strengthening, and aerobic). The majority (89%, n = 213) screened for falls. Only a minority (27%, n = 65) used digital health technology in ALS/MND. This survey investigated the current rehabilitation approaches and digital health technology use among OTs and PTs in ALS/MND. The survey confirmed the diverse and varied roles of OTs and PTs, with overlap in fatigue and spasticity management. Digital health technology use was low among OTs and PTs. These findings can inform future research into rehabilitation practices among OTs and PTs and digital health technologies development in ALS/MND.

items.title: Prevalence of C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansions in a Mexican cohort of sporadic and familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Objective: Pathological hexanucleotide repeat expansions (HRE) in the C9orf72 gene (≥30 repeats) are one of the most common genetic causes of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) in European and North American populations. However, there is limited data on the size and distribution of C9orf72 HRE in admixed populations such as those found in Latin America. In this study, we sought to characterize the role of C9orf72 HRE in a Mexican cohort with ALS. Methods: Peripheral blood samples were obtained from participants of Mexican ancestry attending a multidisciplinary ALS clinic in Northern Mexico ( n = 102) and healthy neurological controls ( n = 75). We performed high-resolution repeat-primed PCR to determine the size and distribution of HRE per allele across both groups. In addition, we used two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov tests to compare allele-level HRE repeat size distributions between ALS cases, healthy controls and a comparative external dataset. Results: We identified three patients (2.9%) carrying pathological C9orf72 repeat expansions, of which two had a family history of ALS and asymptomatic family members with pathological C9orf72 expansions. Notably, all three patients originated from the same region in Northern Mexico. Kolmogorov-Smirnov testing did not identify statistically significant differences between ALS cases, healthy controls, and a comparative dataset. Conclusions: Our findings suggest that pathological C9orf72 expansions may not be a common genetic variant in this population. Additional studies are needed to confirm this observation, as well as determine whether regional genetic variation may play an important role in genetic risk stratification, particularly in admixed ALS populations.
